`data/tcga/processed/test.csv`.

```{python}
#| label: config
import os, sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import pyro
from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.expanduser("~/multiomic_integration/python"))

from run_methods import train_model_single_view, train_model_locally_single_view
from data_utils import summarise_post_samples
```

```{python}
PROJECT_ROOT = os.path.expanduser("~/multiomic_integration")
DATA_DIR     = os.path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, "data/tcga/processed")
OUTPUT_DIR   = os.path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, "sim/results/matrixdecomp/tcga")
Path(OUTPUT_DIR).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# --- Parameters (edit here) ---
K                   = 10
N_POSTERIOR_SAMPLES = 200
RANDOM_SEED         = 42

TRAIN_CONFIG = {
    "initial_lr":      0.01,
    "betas":           (0.9, 0.999),
    "lr_step_size":    10,
    "lr_decay_factor": 0.9,
    "num_particles":   1,
    "minibatch_size":  32,
    "min_epochs":      100,
    "max_epochs":      500,
}
```

## Load data

```{python}
#| label: load-data
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df  = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "test.csv"))

y_train = torch.tensor(train_df["y"].values,                dtype=torch.float32)
y_test  = torch.tensor(test_df["y"].values,                 dtype=torch.float32)
X_train = torch.tensor(train_df.drop(columns=["y"]).values, dtype=torch.float32)
X_test  = torch.tensor(test_df.drop(columns=["y"]).values,  dtype=torch.float32)

print(f"Train: {X_train.shape}  |  Test: {X_test.shape}")

train_subset = TensorDataset(torch.arange(len(y_train)), X_train, y_train)
test_subset  = TensorDataset(torch.arange(len(y_test)),  X_test,  y_test)
```

## Fit MatrixDecomp

```{python}
#| label: train
pyro.clear_param_store()
pyro.set_rng_seed(RANDOM_SEED)

model_config = {"k": K, "dense": False}

factor_model, train_handler, global_runtime = train_model_single_view(
    model_config, TRAIN_CONFIG, train_subset, verbose=False
)
print(f"Global training: {global_runtime:.1f}s, {factor_model.total_epochs} epochs")
```

```{python}
#| label: local-inference
test_handler, local_runtime = train_model_locally_single_view(
    factor_model, TRAIN_CONFIG, test_subset, verbose=False
)
print(f"Local inference: {local_runtime:.1f}s, {factor_model.local_epochs} epochs")
```

## Evaluate

```{python}
#| label: evaluate
post_test      = test_handler.predict([X_test], N_POSTERIOR_SAMPLES, return_sites=["y_pred"])
y_pred_summary = summarise_post_samples(post_test["y_pred"])

y_pred_mean = y_pred_summary["mean"].numpy()
y_pred_q025 = y_pred_summary["q2.5"].numpy()
y_pred_q975 = y_pred_summary["q97.5"].numpy()
y_true_np   = y_test.numpy()

mse      = float(np.mean((y_pred_mean - y_true_np) ** 2))
rmse     = float(np.sqrt(mse))
ss_res   = np.sum((y_pred_mean - y_true_np) ** 2)
ss_tot   = np.sum((y_true_np - y_true_np.mean()) ** 2)
r2       = float(1 - ss_res / ss_tot)
coverage = float(np.mean((y_true_np >= y_pred_q025) & (y_true_np <= y_pred_q975)))

print(f"k={K}  MSE={mse:.4f}  RMSE={rmse:.4f}  R²={r2:.4f}  95% cov={coverage:.3f}")
```

## Save results

```{python}
#| label: save
pred_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "y_true":       y_true_np,
    "y_pred_mean":  y_pred_mean,
    "y_pred_q2.5":  y_pred_q025,
    "y_pred_q97.5": y_pred_q975,
})
pred_df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f"predictions_k{K}.csv"), index=False)

metrics_df = pd.DataFrame([{
    "k": K, "outcome_mse": mse, "outcome_rmse": rmse,
    "outcome_r2": r2, "outcome_95p_cov": coverage,
    "global_runtime": global_runtime, "local_runtime": local_runtime,
    "global_epochs": factor_model.total_epochs, "local_epochs": factor_model.local_epochs,
}])
metrics_df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "all_metrics.csv"), index=False)

print(f"Saved to {OUTPUT_DIR}")
metrics_df
```

# Multiview Model: Expression + Methylation (COAD/READ)

Uses the locally downloaded `coadread_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018` dataset with
`SupMultiviewShared` to jointly model gene expression and DNA methylation for
TMB prediction.

## Configuration

```{python}
#| label: mv-config
import pyro
import torch
from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset
from pathlib import Path

from coadread_data import load_coadread, make_view_list, make_feature_names
from data_utils import normalize_tensor_by_col, zero_variance_col_filter
from run_methods import train_model_shared, train_model_locally_shared
from constants import Sites
```

```{python}
PROJECT_ROOT = os.path.expanduser("~/multiomic_integration")
MV_OUTPUT_DIR = os.path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, "sim/results/integration_shared/coadread")
Path(MV_OUTPUT_DIR).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Views to use — change to ["expr", "meth_body"] or all three as desired
VIEWS = ["expr", "meth_tss200"]

MV_K                   = 20
MV_N_POSTERIOR_SAMPLES = 200
MV_RANDOM_SEED         = 42

MV_MODEL_CONFIG = {
    "k":             MV_K,
    "dense_model":   False,
    "outcome_weight": 1.0,
}
MV_TRAIN_CONFIG = {
    "eta":           0.25,
    "delta":         1e-16,
    "t":             0.1,
    "num_particles": 1,
    "minibatch_fraction": 0.15,
    # "minibatch_size": 32,
    "min_epochs":    200,
    "max_epochs":    1000,
    "convergence_criterion": "elbo_snr",
    "window":        50,
    "snr_threshold": 5,
}
MV_LOCAL_CONFIG = MV_TRAIN_CONFIG #{**MV_TRAIN_CONFIG, "min_epochs": 200}
```

## Load data

```{python}
#| label: mv-load
data = load_coadread(
    top_rna_genes=2000,   # keep 2 000 most-variable RNA genes
    top_meth_genes=1000,  # keep 1 000 most-variable methylation genes per view
    log1p_tmb=True,
    train_frac=0.8,
    random_seed=MV_RANDOM_SEED,
)

print("Overlap summary:")
for k, v in data["overlap_summary"].items():
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")

X_train_views = make_view_list(data, VIEWS, split="train")
X_test_views  = make_view_list(data, VIEWS, split="test")
y_train_raw   = data["y"]
y_test_raw    = data["y_test"]

print(f"\nViews: {VIEWS}")
for v, X in zip(VIEWS, X_train_views):
    print(f"  {v}: train {tuple(X.shape)}  test {tuple(make_view_list(data, [v], 'test')[0].shape)}")
print(f"  y train: {y_train_raw.shape}  test: {y_test_raw.shape}")
```


```{python}
data['X_expr'].shape
```

## Preprocess

```{python}
#| label: mv-preprocess
# Zero-variance filter and normalise each view using training statistics
col_filters = [zero_variance_col_filter(X) for X in X_train_views]

X_train_filtered = [X[:, f] for X, f in zip(X_train_views, col_filters)]
X_test_filtered  = [X[:, f] for X, f in zip(X_test_views,  col_filters)]

norm_stats = [normalize_tensor_by_col(X) for X in X_train_filtered]
X_train_clean = [d["data_clean"] for d in norm_stats]
X_l_mean_list = [d["means"]      for d in norm_stats]
X_l_sd_list   = [d["sds"]        for d in norm_stats]

X_test_clean = [
    normalize_tensor_by_col(X, m, s)["data_clean"]
    for X, m, s in zip(X_test_filtered, X_l_mean_list, X_l_sd_list)
]

# Standardise y (model expects zero-mean unit-variance outcome)
y_mean = y_train_raw.mean()
y_std  = y_train_raw.std()
y_train_clean = (y_train_raw - y_mean) / y_std
y_test_clean  = (y_test_raw  - y_mean) / y_std

n_train = X_train_clean[0].shape[0]
train_subset = TensorDataset(torch.arange(n_train), *X_train_clean, y_train_clean)

n_test = X_test_clean[0].shape[0]
test_subset = TensorDataset(torch.arange(n_test), *X_test_clean, y_test_clean)

print("Train subset tensors:", [tuple(t.shape) for t in train_subset.tensors])
print("Test subset tensors: ", [tuple(t.shape) for t in test_subset.tensors])
```

## Train SupMultiviewShared

```{python}
#| label: mv-train
views_tag = "_".join(VIEWS)
model_out = os.path.join(MV_OUTPUT_DIR, f"model_{views_tag}_k{MV_K}")

pyro.clear_param_store()
pyro.set_rng_seed(MV_RANDOM_SEED)

factor_model, train_handler, global_state = train_model_shared(
    MV_MODEL_CONFIG, MV_TRAIN_CONFIG, train_subset,
    model_out_filename=model_out,
    opt="adagrad",
    verbose=True,
    write=True,
    svd_init=True
)

print(f"\nGlobal training: {global_state['inference_time']:.1f}s, "
      f"{factor_model.total_epochs} epochs")
```

## Local inference on test set

```{python}
#| label: mv-local
factor_model, test_handler, local_state = train_model_locally_shared(
    factor_model, MV_LOCAL_CONFIG, test_subset,
    opt="adagrad", verbose=True,
)
print(f"Local inference: {local_state['inference_time']:.1f}s, "
      f"{factor_model.local_epochs} epochs")
```

## Evaluate

```{python}
#| label: mv-eval
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from data_utils import summarise_post_samples, eval_mse, eval_post_coverage

L = len(VIEWS)
test_sites = [Sites.y_pred, Sites.Z_pred]

post_test = test_handler.predict(X_test_clean, MV_N_POSTERIOR_SAMPLES, test_sites)

# y_pred is in standardised units — rescale back to log1p(TMB) space
y_pred_raw = post_test[Sites.y_pred].squeeze() * y_std + y_mean  # (N_samples, n_test)
y_pred_summary = summarise_post_samples(y_pred_raw)

y_pred_mean = y_pred_summary["mean"]
y_true       = y_test_raw

mse      = eval_mse(y_pred_mean, y_true).item()
rmse     = float(mse ** 0.5)
r2       = float(1 - ((y_pred_mean - y_true) ** 2).sum() / ((y_true - y_true.mean()) ** 2).sum())
coverage = eval_post_coverage(y_true, y_pred_summary["q2.5"], y_pred_summary["q97.5"]).item()

print(f"Views: {VIEWS}  k={MV_K}")
print(f"  MSE={mse:.4f}  RMSE={rmse:.4f}  R²={r2:.4f}  95% cov={coverage:.3f}")

# Scatter: predicted vs actual
y_pred_mean_np = y_pred_mean.numpy()
y_pred_q025_np = y_pred_summary["q2.5"].numpy()
y_pred_q975_np = y_pred_summary["q97.5"].numpy()
y_true_np      = y_true.numpy()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 5))
ax.errorbar(y_true_np, y_pred_mean_np,
            yerr=[y_pred_mean_np - y_pred_q025_np, y_pred_q975_np - y_pred_mean_np],
            fmt="o", alpha=0.4, markersize=3, elinewidth=0.5, color="steelblue")
lims = [min(y_true_np.min(), y_pred_mean_np.min()) - 0.1,
        max(y_true_np.max(), y_pred_mean_np.max()) + 0.1]
ax.plot(lims, lims, "k--", lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("True log1p(TMB)")
ax.set_ylabel("Predicted log1p(TMB)")
ax.set_title(f"{'+ '.join(VIEWS)}  k={MV_K}  R²={r2:.3f}")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Save results

```{python}
#| label: mv-save
pred_df = pd.DataFrame({

print(f"Saved to {MV_OUTPUT_DIR}")
metrics_df
```

## Factor interpretation

```{python}
import importlib
importlib.reload(sys.modules["factor_interpretation"])
```

```{python}
#| label: mv-interpret

from factor_interpretation import summarize_factors, tabulate_top_features, plot_factor_scores_2d, plot_factor_outcome
from constants import Sites, Params

# Read variational means directly from the param store — more reliable than
# running train_handler.predict() on training data, which goes through the
# plate-based forward and can return unexpected shapes.
L = len(VIEWS)
Z_mean      = pyro.param(Params.loc_Z).detach()                                        # (n_train, K)
Lambda_list = [pyro.param(Params.loc_Lambda_l.format(l=l)).detach() for l in range(L)] # list of (p_l, K)
beta_mean   = pyro.param(Params.loc_beta).detach()                                     # (K,)

# Draw beta posterior samples from the Gaussian guide (loc + scale * eps)
loc_beta   = pyro.param(Params.loc_beta).detach()
scale_beta = pyro.param(Params.scale_beta).detach()
beta_samps = loc_beta + scale_beta * torch.randn(MV_N_POSTERIOR_SAMPLES, len(loc_beta))  # (S, K)

# Gene names aligned to the columns that survived the zero-variance filter
raw_names     = make_feature_names(data, VIEWS)
filtered_names = [
    [n for n, keep in zip(names, col_filters[l].tolist()) if keep]
    for l, names in enumerate(raw_names)
]

view_labels = {
    "expr":        "Expression",
    "meth_tss200": "TSS200 Methylation",
    "meth_body":   "Body Methylation",
}
vnames = [view_labels.get(v, v) for v in VIEWS]

# Main summary: PVE + R² plots, printed per-factor table
summary = summarize_factors(
    X_list     = X_train_clean,
    Z          = Z_mean,
    Lambda_list= Lambda_list,
    beta       = beta_mean,
    y          = y_train_clean,      # standardised scale for R²_y
    beta_samples = beta_samps,
    view_names = vnames,
    plot       = True,
    verbose    = True,
    show       = "post"
)
```

```{python}
#| label: mv-loadings-heatmap
from factor_interpretation import plot_factor_loadings

plot_factor_loadings(
    Lambda_list = Lambda_list,
    view_names  = vnames,
    rotate      = True,
    n_factors   = MV_K,
    title       = f"Factor loadings — {' + '.join(vnames)}",
)
```

```{python}
#| label: mv-score-scatter
# Rotated factor scores and top factors by variance explained
from factor_interpretation import _np
Z_rot       = _np(Z_mean) @ summary["R"]                          # (n_train, K)
top_factors = summary["post"]["per_factor"]["factor"].tolist()    # sorted by PVE desc

# Pairwise factor score scatter coloured by TMB
plot_factor_scores_2d(
    Z           = Z_rot,
    y           = y_train_raw.numpy(),
    top_factors = top_factors[:6],
    y_label     = "log1p(TMB)",
    title       = f"Factor scores ({' + '.join(vnames)})",
)
```

```{python}
#| label: mv-score-vs-outcome
# Per-factor score vs TMB (top / bottom 50 comparison + ranked scatter)
plot_factor_outcome(
    Z              = Z_rot,
    y              = y_train_raw.numpy(),
    top_factors    = top_factors[:8],
    n_factors_show = 8,
    outcome_label  = "log1p(TMB)",
    factor_summary = summary,
)
```

```{python}
#| label: mv-top-genes
# Top genes by |loading| per factor, per view
top_gene_tables = tabulate_top_features(
    Lambda_list        = Lambda_list,
    feature_names_list = filtered_names,
    n_top_factors      = 8,
    n_top_features     = 10,
    rotate             = True,
)

for vname, tbl in zip(vnames, top_gene_tables):
    print(f"\n── {vname} ──")
    display(tbl)
```
